text:
morgan: Heads-up: planning a compact rootfs rebuild for runtime images to reduce CVE surface and add signed SBOMs. Need RBAC updates for the build-runner service account and KMS signing access. Targeting next Tue deploy window. Want quick sync on scope and audit logging requirements.

alex: SGTM. Which specific image families/variants are in-scope? Will this touch the canary pool?

morgan: In-scope: redwood/base:2026-02-minimal, redwood/runner:gpu-2026-01, redwood/smoke:alpine-2026. Canary uses runner:gpu-2026-01 in us-west1.
Plan: build artifacts in ephemeral build project, generate SBOMs, cosign attestation using our KMS key alias `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKey`, push signed images to gcr and mirror to region buckets. Rollout staged (5/25/50/100).

sam: Need to confirm ephemeral build project has restricted network egress for private customers. Also we should require attestation records to be copied to our central audit GCS bucket.

lee: For compliance: we need explicit audit entries for both the sign event and the artifact push. Please write a short schema for the audit export. Destination: `gs://redwood-audit/image-attest` and forward logs to our SIEM (stackdriver->pubsub->splunk). Also include who triggered the sign (service account) and PR/approval id.

morgan: Agreed. Proposed audit event fields: `artifact_digest`, `cosign_signature_id`, `kms_key`, `signer_sa`, `git_pr`, `approval_label`, `build_id`, `timestamp`, `sbom_hash`. I'll add to the runbook.

nate: RBAC question: we should not broadly grant `cloudkms.cryptoSigner` to the build-runner SA. Limit via IAM to specific key and add a condition: only allowed when `request.auth.claims.build_id` present or when invoked from the ephemeral-build project. Also require Cloud Build manual approval for prod signing.

morgan: Yeah, thinking of a constrained binding. Example IAM binding we plan to propose in the PR: 

```
members:
  - serviceAccount:build-runner@redwood-ephemeral.iam.gserviceaccount.com
role: roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier
resource: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKey/cryptoKeys/signer
condition:
  title: "ephemeral-build-only"
  expression: "request.auth.aud == 'cloud-build' && resource.name.startsWith('projects/redwood-ephemeral')"
```

alex: That looks reasonable. For runtime, during canary we should have automatic fallback to the previous image if token-perf regresses >5% or error-rate >1%. Is that in the rollout plan?

morgan: Yes. Rollout will be traffic-shifted with the following health checks: liveness, readiness, `token_latency_p95`, and `generation_error_rate`. If any check trips the rollback policy will mark the canary unhealthy and revert.

deploy-bot: CI: #ci-image-build started for redwood/runner:gpu-2026-01-minimal (build_id: bld-20260308-1122). See https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/bld-20260308-1122 :building_man:

sam: Remote attestation for private customers: we need a path to re-sign or produce an offline verification bundle so on-prem customers who can't reach KMS can still validate provenance. Suggest we export cosign bundle + SBOM into `gs://redwood-audit/offline-bundles/<build_id>.tar.gz` and document verification steps.

lee: I'll open a compliance ticket and add required checklist items: RBAC least privilege, audit forwarding, offline bundle retention (90 days), and legal-approved KMS usage text. SLA for review: 48h.

nate: Also recommend rotating the signing key after this batch completes and adding a key-use audit (who signed what) to quarterly reviews.

morgan: Good call. I'll: 1) open RBAC PR with the tight IAM binding, 2) add audit export config and offline-bundle job, 3) update runbook with staged rollout + rollback thresholds and add @nate @sam as approvers. Will ping when PR is up. :thumbsup:

lee: :eyes: thanks, please tag compliance ticket in the PR.

alex: I'll schedule canary windows in us-west1 and eu-west1 and wire health checks to the rollout controller.

morgan: Thanks everyone. Action items: morgan -> PR for IAM/audit/runbook; sam -> confirm ephemeral project egress limits; nate -> add KMS rotation plan; lee -> compliance ticket and checklist.

morgan: pinging here once PR is open @sam @nate @lee
